visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair and glasses wearing a white short-sleeved school uniform shirt and khaki pants holds a red-handled broom like a sword, lunging forward with an exaggerated heroic facial expression. The background consists of a textured stone wall and lush green bushes in daylight. (2) Another man (or the same actor) appears wearing a blue Adidas tracksuit jacket and a black cap, gesturing aggressively with his hands like a cartoon villain. (3) The first man swings the broom towards the villain character. White variety-show captions appear at the top and bottom of the frame. (4) A man dressed in a green military-style disciplinary officer uniform with a cap and insignia appears, pointing his finger and shouting. (5) The scene shifts to a sunny park with trees and a pathway. The schoolboy stands stiffly while the officer character speaks to him. (6) The officer sits on a wooden park bench, covering his eyes and appearing to cry or act emotionally distressed. The schoolboy stands beside him, looking concerned. (7) The schoolboy holds a modern gold-colored smartphone, showing the screen to the camera and the officer. The screen displays a colorful vertical RPG game interface with characters and combat icons. (8) Close-up shots of the phone screen show game menus, reward animations, and character lists with the title '神召守護隊'. (9) The man in the school uniform is seen sitting on the bench, interacting with the phone, gesturing towards the screen with an excited expression. (10) The final shot shows the schoolboy in a 'punishment' squat position against a pole in the park, hands outstretched as if holding invisible objects, with the broom leaning against the pole.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main creator playing three distinct roles (student, villain, officer) usually appearing 1 or 2 at a time through editing.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A man with medium-length black hair and black-rimmed glasses, wearing a white school uniform shirt, khaki trousers, and white sneakers. He also appears as an officer in a green military uniform and a villain in a blue tracksuit.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video starts in a courtyard area with a stone building wall and bushes. Later, it moves to a public park with paved paths, trees, a wooden bench, and a lamp post.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-arousal male vocal shouting with exaggerated heroic pitch variability. Accompanied by quick synthetic 'whoosh' SFX and a dramatic orchestral string BGM. (2) Vocal shifts to an authoritative, louder tone with lower pitch, representing an officer character. BGM cuts out, leaving slight outdoor ambient floor. (3) A sudden cartoon-style 'impact' SFX triggers a scene transition. (4) BGM transitions to a sentimental, slow-tempo solo piano melody. The vocal becomes soft, breathy, and melodramatic, conveying a story of past regret. (5) Fast-paced digital 'ding' and 'pop' SFX occur frequently as the speaker shifts to a high-density, energetic promotional narrative. Upbeat, moderate-tempo pop music with electronic percussion swells in the background. (6) Audio track concludes with a final 'squatting' action cue and a humorous vocal remark followed by a fade-out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Conflict -> Empathy -> Product Integration -> Reward/CTA -> Gag Outro
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the mobile game '神召守護隊' using a comedic skit. It leverages a common school scenario (acting out fantasies during cleaning) and flips it into a shared emotional moment with a strict officer to highlight the game's idle gameplay and heroic theme.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video features a dedicated segment explaining the game's features, a screen capture of the gameplay, a specific referral code (GDHOWHOWPLAY), and a clear call to action for downloads.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video is a classic example of social-native advertising where a content creator's established comedic style is used to mask a full-length commercial for a mobile game. The high production density and varied emotional beats keep viewer engagement before transitioning to the sales pitch.
